whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Broccoli Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has great 4.0★ reviews on Fraser Road in Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for direct table bookings and local customer inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur table reservation integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://broccoli-cafe-demo.arclane.workers.dev

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Broccoli Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a mobile-friendly menu showcase and direct WhatsApp booking for your location on Fraser Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
